IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_Storm_TypeTooltip: A thunderstorm, a tropical storm (more wind, rain and fog, one huge thunder cloud), or a blizzard (snow when it is cold enough, and no lightning unless you set thunder clouds below).
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_Storm_FromTooltip: The side the storm comes from, as on the world map (north is up). Its thunder clouds cross the whole map from that side to the opposite one. Vanilla's trigger buttons always send it from the west.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_Storm_OverTooltip: Where the thunder clouds aim: where that player is when the storm itself begins, an hour after Start. A cloud takes the whole storm to cross the map and is overhead about halfway through. If the player has gone offline by then, a random player is used instead. Vanilla aims only its first cloud at a random player, and only above 70% strength.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_Storm_OverAnywhere: A random spot on the map
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_Storm_TemperatureTo: A warm front, as in vanilla's storms, makes it up to 7 degrees Celsius colder while the storm is at its strongest; a cold front makes it up to 7 degrees warmer.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_Storm_HoursTooltip: How long the storm itself lasts, in game hours. The game adds an hour of build-up before it and an hour of clearing after it, as for vanilla's trigger buttons.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_Storm_StrengthToolt: How strong the weather front is: how hard it rains and blows and how dark it gets. Unless set below, it also sets how wide the thunder clouds are, how often they flash or rumble and how much of that is lightning. Vanilla's trigger buttons always use 95%.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_Storm_OptionalInfo: Ticked settings replace what the game would choose:
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_Storm_CloudsTooltip: How many thunder clouds cross the map, each over the target chosen above. Vanilla makes 1 or 2 (a tropical storm 1, a blizzard none), the second over a random spot.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_Storm_WidthTooltip: The thunder clouds' radius in tiles. Their flashes and rumbles happen within half of it, so a narrow storm keeps the lightning close to its path. Vanilla: 8000 times the strength, 15000 for a tropical storm.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_Storm_FrequencyTool: How often each cloud flashes or rumbles: at 100% every 0.5 to 4 seconds, at 0% every 3.5 to 24 seconds (real time at normal speed). Vanilla uses the storm's strength, 100% for a tropical storm.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_Storm_LightningTool: How many of those are lightning, a flash with thunder; the rest are a distant rumble with no flash. Vanilla: 60% of the strength, 80% for a tropical storm.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_Storm_WindTooltip: The wind speed while the storm is on; it still picks up and dies down with the storm. Vanilla's storms blow between about a fifth and most of the maximum, gusting. The Climate tab's Wind setting still wins over this.

IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_StepDel: How long to wait after the step before this one, in milliseconds (1000 = one second). 0 runs this step at the same moment, in the same frame. The default of 300 keeps commands reaching the server in order.

Flips from its own state; Sync only leaves it out.

Used when the shortcut's 'On click' is Update and sync or Sync only. Step 1 is the shortcut's own action: with Same state this step turns on when step 1 is on and off when it is off, with Opposite state the other way round. An independent step flips from its own state, and Sync only leaves it out. With 'On click' on Flip each, every step flips from its own state and this setting is not used.
The shortcut's own action is not a toggle (or opens its window), so this step flips from its own state until it is.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_OnClick: Every toggle flips from its own state.
Step 1 flips; the steps that follow it turn to its new state.
Step 1 stays as it is; the steps that follow it turn to its current state. Other steps do not run.
No step follows step 1 (each toggle step's 'Follow step 1' is Independent), so this works like Flip each. Set it on the steps (right-click, Steps, Edit).
No step follows step 1 (each toggle step's 'Follow step 1' is Independent), so a click does nothing. Set it on the steps (right-click, Steps, Edit).

How the shortcut's own action (step 1) and its toggle steps turn, for example god mode with invisible as a step. Flip each: every toggle flips from its own state (god mode off and invisible on become god mode on and invisible off). Update and sync: step 1 flips and the steps that follow it turn to its new state (god mode off and invisible on become both on; both off become both on). Sync only: step 1 is left as it is and the steps that follow it turn to its current state (god mode off and invisible on become both off); other steps do not run. Whether a step follows step 1 is set on each step. When step 1's state cannot be read (another player this client has never seen), Update and sync flips each step on its own and Sync only does nothing. Has no effect while 'Open the window instead' is ticked.
IGUI_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_SyncUpd: Click: toggles step 1, the following steps turn to its new state.

Runs the whole shortcut, steps included, again and again: Until clicked again starts on a click and stops on the next click (or its key), While held runs while the mouse button or key stays down. Every is the wait between runs in milliseconds, from 100 (ten a second) up; 1000 = one second. Times stops after that many runs.
